aiOverview.content: Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift is an upcoming high-speed, outdoor, spinning roller coaster opening at Universal Studios Hollywood in Summer 2026. Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift is an upcoming high-speed, outdoor, spinning roller coaster opening at Universal Studios Hollywood in Summer 2026. It features 360-degree rotating cars designed to simulate drifting at speeds up to 72 mph, with a 4,100-foot track that crosses over the park's Starway escalator. This video provides a first look at the ride vehicles and track for the new roller coaster:16:37Magic Family AdventuresYouTube• Mar 11, 2026 16:37 Key Details of Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift Location: Universal Studios Hollywood (Upper Lot). Opening: Summer 2026. Ride Experience: High-speed, 360-degree rotating cars designed to simulate drifting. Speed: Up to 72 mph. Track Length: 4,100 feet. Vehicles: Themed to iconic Fast & Furious cars, including Dom's 1970 Dodge Charger, Han's Mazda RX-7, Brian's Nissan Skyline GT-R, and Toyota Supra. Status: Currently in the testing phase, with riders spotted in early April 2026. You can watch this video to see the roller coaster in action during testing:11:46Theme Park ObsessionYouTube• Mar 18, 2026 11:46 Additional Information Sound Mitigation: Due to proximity to residential areas, sound-reduction technology is installed, including two half-pipe-style sound shields. Future Florida Location: A similar "Fast & Furious: Hollywood Drift" coaster is also planned for Universal Studios Florida, announced for a 2027 opening. Note: The current Fast & Furious – Supercharged tram tour attraction in Hollywood officially closed on March 10, 2025.
